question: What precise location and manner are prescribed for drawing and drinking air as a practice?
premises: Air is to be taken as the object of practice.
It is to be placed at the root of the tongue and palate.
It is to be drunk slowly.
inference: Having placed the air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
uncertainties: The purpose of this practice is not stated in this verse
plain_english: Having placed the air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
